## Level-Up Flow

**When offered:** Worker computes `shouldLevelUp(character)` (`worker/src/services/character.ts:159`) = `xp >= XP_THRESHOLDS[level]` (thresholds: 0/300/900/2700/6500/14000/23000/34000/48000/64000, max level 10). Returned as `canLevelUp` from `POST /api/action` (`routes/action.ts:99`) and `POST /api/combat/resolve` (`routes/combat.ts:109`). Frontend pre-computes the same in `CharacterStateService.checkLevelUp` (`character-state.service.ts:52,76`) but the server value wins (`game-console.component.ts:128,155`). UI surfaces it as a banner (`character-sheet.component.html:66`) and an ability-choice picker (`game-console.component.html:19-28`).

**Trigger & endpoint:** `game-console.component.ts:183` `levelUp(key)` → `GameApiService.levelUp(sessionId, characterId, abilityChoice)` (`game-api.service.ts:74`) → `POST /api/levelup` (`worker/src/routes/levelup.ts:10`). `abilityChoice` must be one of str/dex/con/int/wis/cha (400 otherwise, `:23-25`); 400 if `!shouldLevelUp` (`:31`).

**Character changes** (`services/character.ts:133` `levelUp`):
- `level` +1
- HP gain = `roll(class hit die) + CON mod`, added to both `max_hp` and current HP (class hit dice: Fighter/Ranger d10, Rogue/Cleric/Bard d8, Wizard d6)
- Chosen ability score **+2** (no cap at 20)
- AC unchanged

**Response/logging:** `routes/levelup.ts:39-50` generates flavor text (usually fallback text per bug B-03), writes a `system` log row `[Level Up] …`, and adds a DM history turn. Frontend then calls `setCharacter`, `setCanLevelUp(false)`, shows a system message, and updates campaign slot level (`game-console.component.ts:187-194`).

One level per call — a character with enough XP for two levels must call the endpoint twice.
